integrity: All asserted formulas are derived by a unitary Zak multiplier and a finite-dimensional ellipsoid-volume identity. Supplementary deterministic checks are not substitutes for the proofs. No exhaustive literature novelty guarantee is claimed.
limitations: Only the centered triangular B-spline, integer modulation, unit-period translation offsets and uniform independent shift phases are treated. The exact low-bound law holds for \(0<a<1/4\), and the general exact condition-number tail only for \(K>4m\). No independent validation has been performed.
title: Exact Pareto conditioning for random-periodic tent-spline Gabor frames
